attempts.text:
**The window starts on the `cus` cluster.** Columns 0 to 3, `cusF`, `cusC`, `cusR` and `cusS`, are spine columns, carried by 93 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, and the model names them in 98 to 99% of calls with no column above 0.13 bits. Only 0.2 to 94% of calls there fall in a region of plasticity.

**Then the graph opens into fork and variable columns.** Columns 4 to 79 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 12 to 95% of calls, and the model names 74 to 96% of genes. The most hesitant column is column 6, `ybcH`, at 1.98 bits, in a region of plasticity in 95% of calls; column 4, `nrfB`, follows at 1.92 bits, and column 7, `envY`, at 1.53 bits. The 26 columns where most calls are in a region of plasticity are named in 86% of calls at 0.82 bits, the other 54 in 92% at 0.43 bits.

**Branches run beside the most carried families.** Through columns 17 to 21 a branch of 5 families, from an outer membrane beta-barrel family to `phage minor tail protein L`, is carried by 13 to 16% of chromosomes, all shell. Columns 27 to 30 carry a branch of 4 families, 15%, and columns 31 to 39 a branch of 9, from `head decoration protein` to `rzpD`, 13 to 21%. Later branches run through columns 46 to 50, 56 to 59, 65 to 68, 69 to 72 and 77 to 79, the last, `maa` to `pdeB`, carried by 16 to 24% of chromosomes, all persistent.

**The middle is a run of forks.** `folD` at column 14 is persistent in 88% of chromosomes, `ybcJ` in 86%, and the `all` and `glx` genes, [[allantoate and glyoxylate catabolism]], fill columns 26 to 39. `fetA` and `fetB`, [[iron efflux]], sit at columns 49 and 50, and `acrA` and `acrB`, [[multidrug efflux]], at columns 77 and 78. The window ends at column 79, `tomB`, in 38% of chromosomes.

**Across the window the model names 90% of genes** at 0.55 bits, perplexity 1.7 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.01 against 0.20 bits, and names fewer genes, 82% against 97%; 18,838 of the 42,800 calls are inside a region of plasticity. Persistent calls are named 99% at 0.16 bits, shell 81% at 0.99 bits, cloud 22% at 3.14 bits.

label: cusF
facts:
WINDOW: the cusF window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor cusF, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,163 to 3,242 from dnaA. Read in 535 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying cusF once); 42,800 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 90% of genes, 0.55 bits on average (perplexity 1.7 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 23,836 calls, named 99%, 0.16 bits; shell 18,389 calls, named 81%, 0.99 bits; cloud 575 calls, named 22%, 3.14 bits. Outside an RGP 23,962 calls, named 97%, 0.20 bits; inside an RGP 18,838 calls, named 82%, 1.01 bits. Columns: 4 spine, 57 fork, 19 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.01 against 0.20 bits) and names fewer genes (82% against 97%); 18,838 of the 42,800 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 6 (ybcH) 1.98 bits, RGP 95%; column 4 (nrfB) 1.92 bits, RGP 94%; column 7 (envY) 1.53 bits, RGP 95%. The 26 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 86%, 0.82 bits on average; the other 54 columns: named 92%, 0.43 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 0-3 (spine), RGP 0.2-94%; the least: columns 4-79 (fork and variable columns), RGP 12-95%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-3 (4 columns) spine: share 93-100%, all P, RGP 0.2-94%. Genes: cusF, cusC "Cu(+)/Ag(+) efflux RND transporter…", cusR, cusS. named 98-99% (mean 98%), fewest named at column 1 (cusC), named 98%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.13 bits (column 2 (cusR)).
2. columns 4-79 (76 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 12-95%. named 74-96% (mean 90%), fewest named at column 4, named 74%; most hesitant at column 6, 1.98 bits.
